ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to students graduating in Spring, Summer, or Fall 2021. Contact NRES Student Services at nres-ssc@illinois.edu to request enrollment. Please include your UIN and anticipated graduation semester. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
